lineage.v7_role: historical architecture and outer-custody anchor only; not an executable metric or non-regression baseline
lineage.v8_role: implemented offline evaluation runner with a deterministic synthetic preflight; no buyer or field evaluation has been completed

allowed_now: A historical read-only EchoLock and HyperCore architecture exists.
The historical code provides a read-only API shell, telemetry logging, file hashing, and no-actuation controls.
A buyer-scoped offline validation protocol can be prepared without touching production controls.
The V8 offline runner passes deterministic, source-tamper, null-floor, chronology, baseline, and fail-closed tests on a synthetic fixture.
blocked_now: universal phase locking or coherence superiority

current_evidence_limits: The historical V7 coherence score is derived from CPU and memory utilization rather than a validated cross-layer operational target.
The historical ROI conversion uses assumed load, energy price, and efficiency-per-coherence-point constants.
The archived validation note does not record a dataset, sampling rates, null-model result, ablation result, or V7 non-regression result.
The outer V7 archive hash matches its manifest, but inner log bytes, inner hashes, README claims, and freeze self-hashes do not reconcile.
Historical LumenLab V6 and V13 headlines are quarantined because their evaluation is in-sample or leaks holdout information.
Historical tournament results are quarantined when missing features are replaced with random values.
Broad live-breadth counts are not evidence while source manifests include virtual-environment test datasets.
The V8 synthetic preflight validates runner mechanics only; it is not external validation, buyer acceptance, or evidence of operational or economic benefit.
V9 remains a roadmap definition, not a completed evaluation.
The historical freeze contains large environment and duplicate payloads that must not become the reviewer package.

required_source_contract.cross_layer_rule: A cross-layer claim requires synchronized power, cooling or thermal, and compute signals. A single-layer bundle permits only a single-layer detector claim.
prohibited_inputs: post-holdout labels used during model selection

chronology.holdout_window: untouched until the protocol and artifact hashes are sealed
leakage_controls: features use only information available at decision time
normalization is fit on development data only
thresholds are frozen before holdout scoring
all excluded periods are declared before scoring
negative and inconclusive outcomes remain in the result packet

frozen_metric_formulas.coherence_c: Welch magnitude-squared coherence on preregistered signal pairs, frequency bands, windows, and lags
frozen_metric_formulas.distance_omega: regularized Mahalanobis distance fit on development data only
frozen_metric_formulas.delta_omega: past-only change in omega over a preregistered horizon
frozen_metric_formulas.stability_s: recovery time and recovery-area measures after independently adjudicated incidents
frozen_metric_formulas.efficiency_e: measured CPU seconds and peak memory for the replay; facility energy requires a synchronized meter
frozen_metric_formulas.formula_gate: Every formula, band, lag, normalization, and threshold is frozen before holdout outcomes are observed.

registered_baselines.role: buyer-named operational reference required when one exists

additional_checks: single-layer ablations for power, cooling, and compute
legacy V7 parity only after an executable formula and reference data are frozen
required_falsification.multiplicity_rule: Apply Holm adjustment across registered bands, lags, endpoints, baselines, and candidates.

deliverables: offline replay with wins, non-wins, and abstentions
seed ledger, split manifest, and threshold receipt
per-incident outputs and incident-clustered confidence intervals
resource measurements, failures, abstentions, and negative results
runner_test_contract: metrics remain bounded where their contracts declare bounds
missing, constant, and irregular signals fail or abstain explicitly
features and thresholds never access future or holdout data
runner performs no network or control writes
thresholds remain immutable after calibration freeze
source whitelist and authorization receipt are enforced
null and ablation outcomes are retained
incident-clustered confidence intervals use incident episodes rather than rows as independent units
independent reproduction remains a separate external gate
human_gates: Buyer identity and recipient fit are reviewed before outreach.
Buyer authorizes every source and defines protected-data handling.
Buyer and reviewer approve baselines, metrics, exclusions, and thresholds before holdout scoring.
Founder approves exact price, contract terms, recipient, and external send.
No production connection, control write, public performance claim, or economic claim occurs without a separate action-time approval and receipt.
